intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Someone has handed you a cup of tea. You lift it to drink, and Senna takes it out of your hands.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She sniffs it. Then she dips a paper strip from her apron into it and squints at the strip.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Stewed. Four sugars. Whoever made this hates teeth.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “I’ve smelled about four hundred cups of tea at this court. I’ve drunk none of them.”

options.labelText: “Thanks, but I can check my own tea.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She hands it back. You drink it. Four sugars is a lot of sugars.

options.labelText: “Want your own? You can smell it first. Twice, if you like.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You find her a cup. She inspects it for twice as long as yours, then drinks it.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Still bad. My face has gone warm. I’m blaming the tea.”
